_about: What must never become false (AAA v7.1 section 5), from the bible's 'what must never be sacrificed' (docs/design/BIBLE.md section 16) and the project's own rules. Each invariant names its verifier as res://path.gd::test_function. status: verified (the verifier exists and the gate runs it), pending (to be built; allowed until the release gate) or review (judged by a person, not a test). tests/design/test_constitution.gd checks this file. Only the integrator edits it; no builder weakens a verifier to make it pass.

invariants.name: magic_is_beautiful
invariants.statement: Every cast response presents the magic (a magic or camera step), and no outcome or line frames magic as a punishment.

invariants.name: the_witch_is_fun
invariants.statement: She keeps her wit, generosity, theatricality and ridiculousness in every act.

invariants.name: miron_chooses
invariants.statement: No knowledge effect makes Miron's motive, the Fog's nature or what the last night was ESTABLISHED; the Fog is never written as simply evil.

invariants.name: the_rescue_works
invariants.statement: Pulled at the threshold, Miron comes through: a sim reaches act5_he_stood_here.

invariants.name: the_garden_cannot_be_restored
invariants.statement: Once garden_below is fading or dust, no action sets it back.

invariants.name: independent_agency
invariants.statement: Every named townsperson changes state at least once without the witch acting on them.

invariants.name: no_universal_social_solution
invariants.statement: For Vera, the same kind of act has opposite outcomes in two contexts.

invariants.name: magic_returns_without_restoring
invariants.statement: After act VII, Miron is still in the Fog on every authored route.

invariants.name: the_ending_needs_no_explanation
invariants.statement: The ending is reachable while act9_what_happened and act5_would_he_come are UNRESOLVED_BY_DESIGN.

invariants.name: the_postgame_adds_meaning_not_exoneration
invariants.statement: postgame_he_asked_her is SUPPORTED at most, never ESTABLISHED; postgame_he_left and postgame_he_chose stay true beside it.

invariants.name: no_meters
invariants.statement: No player-visible text shows a number, percent or score about a person, and nothing presents a relationship meter.

invariants.name: russian_only_one_table
invariants.statement: All player-visible text lives in the text table, and nowhere else.

invariants.name: zero_load_warnings
invariants.statement: The game scope's catalog loads with zero errors and zero warnings.

invariants.name: deterministic_replay
invariants.statement: The same steps make the same event chain.

invariants.name: save_load_identity
invariants.statement: Saving and loading mid-run ends on the identical chain head.

invariants.name: the_verbs_stay_hidden
invariants.statement: No engine identifier or verb name reaches the player's text.

invariants.name: event_budget
invariants.statement: A six-hour idle session commits fewer events than the store's cap.

invariants.name: no_softlock
invariants.statement: From every reachable state of an act, the act's exit stays reachable.

invariants.name: acts_only_move_forward
invariants.statement: No action moves story.act to an earlier act.

invariants.name: the_flower_has_no_use
invariants.statement: The ordinary flower offers no cast and no taking, and records nothing but having been seen.

authority_ceiling: No builder edits this file, the integrator-owned files (docs/design/GAME_SPEC.md section 7) or the gate scripts.
No builder weakens, skips or deletes a test to make the gate pass.
No builder pushes; the integrator merges and pushes after an independent check.
